opening.text: Dominance ticked down to 58.4% and the 60% forced-exit line stopped closing. BTC hedge is green on day one. Book is +12.0% on $1,784.61 cost. Nothing broken; the question today is allocation, not survival.

NEAR is the trade. NRR listed Sep 29 — the catalyst that carried it from $3.57 to $5.36 has been paid out. +180% in thirty days with a spent event is not a hold, it is a gift. Trim $100, keep 24.47 coins as the runner, and stop pretending the $4.20 break is the only valid signal.

Redeploying into ONDO, not QNT. QNT's Clearing House deal is genuinely the biggest institutional print of the quarter, and QNT is also up 317% in seven days and already 19% off the high. You do not buy week one of a 5x. ONDO carries the same RWA narrative with negative funding and an 8.3% weight. Boring is the point.

Honest accounting: 1.95% in fees to rotate inside the same sector is expensive for a thesis this fine. ZEC is still the real exposure — underwater, 27 days held, and one delisting headline from a forced exit. LINK at 20.6% is the next weight problem, not an opportunity.
